mapper.sql: FROM TB_IDEA I LEFT JOIN TB_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ID000002' AND TC.CODE_ID = I.IDEA_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP_ID = 'ID000001' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_AGT A ON A.AGENT_ID = I.AGENT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = I.CREATE_ID
mapper.select:
/* 아이디어 목록 조회 idea.selectIdeaList */ SELECT I.IDEA_ID , I.IDEA_TYPE_CD , TC.CODE_NM AS IDEA_TYPE_NM , I.AGENT_ID , A.AGENT_NM , I.TITLE , I.STATUS_CD , SC.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , I.LIKE_CNT , CASE WHEN I.CMT_CONTENT IS NULL OR I.CMT_CONTENT = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS CMT_YN , I.CREATE_ID , U.USER_NM AS CREATE_NM , DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREATE_DT
ORDER BY I.CREATE_DT DESC, I.IDEA_ID DESC LIMIT #{firstIndex}, #{recordCountPerPage}
/* 아이디어 목록 건수 idea.selectIdeaListCnt */ SELECT COUNT(1)

/* 아이디어 엑셀용 전체 목록 (페이징 없음) idea.selectIdeaExcelList */ SELECT I.IDEA_ID , TC.CODE_NM AS IDEA_TYPE_NM , A.AGENT_NM , I.TITLE , U.USER_NM AS CREATE_NM , DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREATE_DT , I.LIKE_CNT , SC.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM
ORDER BY I.CREATE_DT DESC, I.IDEA_ID DESC

/* 아이디어 상세 조회 idea.selectIdeaDetail */ SELECT I.IDEA_ID , I.IDEA_TYPE_CD , TC.CODE_NM AS IDEA_TYPE_NM , I.AGENT_ID , A.AGENT_NM , I.TITLE , I.CONTENT , I.STATUS_CD , SC.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , I.LIKE_CNT , CASE WHEN L.USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS LIKED_YN , I.CMT_CONTENT , I.CMT_USER_ID , CU.USER_NM AS CMT_USER_NM , DATE_FORMAT(I.CMT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CMT_DT , CASE WHEN I.CMT_CONTENT IS NULL OR I.CMT_CONTENT = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS CMT_YN , I.CREATE_ID , U.USER_NM AS CREATE_NM , DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREATE_DT
LEFT JOIN TB_USER CU ON CU.USER_ID = I.CMT_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_IDEA_LIKE L ON L.IDEA_ID = I.IDEA_ID AND L.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE I.IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 아이디어 첨부파일 목록 idea.selectIdeaFileList */ SELECT IDEA_FILE_ID , IDEA_ID , FILE_PATH , FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE FROM TB_IDEA_FILE WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT ASC, IDEA_FILE_ID ASC

/* 아이디어 첨부파일 단건 (삭제된 글의 파일은 제외) idea.selectIdeaFile */ SELECT F.IDEA_FILE_ID , F.IDEA_ID , F.FILE_PATH , F.FILE_NM , F.FILE_SIZE , F.FILE_TYPE FROM TB_IDEA_FILE F INNER JOIN TB_IDEA I ON I.IDEA_ID = F.IDEA_ID AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE F.IDEA_FILE_ID = #{ideaFileId}
/* 아이디어 공통코드 목록 (ID000001 진행상태 / ID000002 구분) idea.selectIdeaCodeList */ SELECT CODE_ID , CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID = #{codeGrpId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD ASC, CODE_ID ASC
/* 아이디어 등록용 에이전트 목록 idea.selectIdeaAgentList */ SELECT AGENT_ID , AGENT_NM FROM TB_AGT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD ASC, AGENT_NM ASC
mapper.update: /* 관리자 진행상태·코멘트 저장 (코멘트를 비우면 삭제) idea.updateIdeaManage MySQL은 SET을 왼쪽부터 적용하므로 CMT_DT·CMT_USER_ID를 CMT_CONTENT보다 먼저 계산 (내용이 같으면 기존 값 유지) */ UPDATE TB_IDEA SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd} , CMT_DT = CASE WHEN IFNULL(#{cmtContent}, '') = '' THEN NULL WHEN IFNULL(CMT_CONTENT, '') = #{cmtContent} THEN CMT_DT ELSE NOW() END , CMT_USER_ID = CASE WHEN IFNULL(#{cmtContent}, '') = '' THEN NULL WHEN IFNULL(CMT_CONTENT, '') = #{cmtContent} THEN CMT_USER_ID ELSE #{cmtUserId} END , CMT_CONTENT = NULLIF(#{cmtContent}, '') , MODIFY_DT = NOW() , MODIFY_ID = #{modifyId} WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.delete: /* 아이디어 첨부파일 단건 삭제 idea.deleteIdeaFile */ DELETE FROM TB_IDEA_FILE WHERE IDEA_FILE_ID = #{ideaFileId}
mapper.select: /* 추천 여부 idea.selectIdeaLikeCnt */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_IDEA_LIKE WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.delete: /* 추천 취소 idea.deleteIdeaLike */ DELETE FROM TB_IDEA_LIKE WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
